name: Elin Rhys
bio:
Elin Rhys brings a decade of experience in financial management to the high-stakes world of motorsport. Originally from Cardiff, she traded a stable career in corporate banking for the adrenaline and precision of racing. Elin thrives under pressure, ensuring financial stability and strategic resource allocation, allowing racing teams to push their performance to the limit. 

Her meticulous approach to budgeting and keen eye for identifying cost-saving opportunities has earned her a reputation for getting the most out of every pound. Beyond the numbers, Elin understands the human element of racing, recognizing that financial security enables innovation and confident performance, giving her the edge over her competitors. Her commitment to transparency and collaborative problem-solving fosters trust within teams, solidifying her position as a key asset.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered, often pulled back in a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Elin has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor that commands respect.

quirks: Always has a backup spreadsheet printed out, even if she doesn't need it.
Insists on using a specific brand of black pen for all official documents.
Listens to classical music through noise-canceling headphones while crunching numbers.
